title: MET 2026 Phase 1 Examination
description: The MET (Manipal Entrance Test) is an online computer-based examination conducted by Manipal Academy of Higher Education (MAHE). The exam pattern consists of multiple-choice questions (MCQs) from Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, and English, with a fixed time duration and negative marking for incorrect answers.
